lines.beaver_en: What trends are there in movies these days?
lines.learner: 요즘은 실화를 다룬 영화가 많이 개봉해요.
lines.en: These days, a lot of movies based on true stories are coming out.
lines.roman: yojeumeun silhwareul darun yeonghwaga mani gaebonghaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Do true-story movies do well at the box office?
lines.learner: 네, 실화라서 감동이 커서 흥행이 잘돼요.
lines.en: Yes, since they're true stories, they're very moving, so they do well.
lines.roman: ne, silhwaraseo gamdong-i keoseo heunghaeng-i jaldwaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: What kind of stories are popular?
lines.learner: 시나리오가 탄탄하고 인물이 현실적인 게 인기예요.
lines.en: Ones with solid scripts and realistic characters are popular.
lines.roman: sinarioga tantanhago inmuri hyeonsiljeogin ge in-giyeyo.

lines.en: Many have open endings, and the reviews are good too.

lines.beaver_en: Is it the same with animation?
lines.en: In animation, more works now include traditional Korean music.

lines.beaver_en: Traditional music? What kind of music?
lines.learner: 가야금 소리와 장단을 통해서 분위기를 살려요.
lines.en: They set the mood through gayageum sounds and rhythms.
lines.roman: gayageum soriwa jangdaneul tonghaeseo bunwigireul sallyeoyo.

lines.en: Documentaries about calligraphy and crafts are popular.

lines.beaver_en: Who watches that? Is it fun?
lines.learner: 붓글씨 쓰는 장면이 멋있어서 젊은 사람도 많이 봐요.
lines.en: The calligraphy scenes are cool, so lots of young people watch.
lines.roman: butgeulssi sseuneun jangmyeoni meosisseoseo jeolmeun saramdo mani bwayo.

lines.beaver_en: How are other fields these days?
lines.learner: 요즘은 발라드 가수가 영화 주연도 맡아요.
lines.en: These days, ballad singers even take lead roles in films.
lines.roman: yojeumeun balladeu gasuga yeonghwa juyeondo matayo.

lines.beaver_en: Interesting. Let's go to a preview screening next time!
lines.en: Sounds good! Let's see it early together at the preview.
